style: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: full-screen loading illustration for TUMP, a playful 3D game about knocking over a tin can with a rubber slipper and retrieving it. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, ideally 1920x1080. Art direction: confident flat-color screen-print poster, deliberately chunky squared-off shapes echoing a cute blocky game world, dark warm ink outlines with small controlled line-weight changes, clean geometric shadows, limited warm ochre / persimmon / deep-brown palette with restrained scene-specific accents. Purposeful material details only; clear large silhouettes. No people, faces, invented heroes, lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, gradients pretending to be paint, cinematic bloom, photographic realism, smeary foliage, ornamental clutter, or glossy generic concept art. Keep the bottom quarter and top-left corner quiet for separately rendered loading tips and logo; put the pictorial interest in the upper-middle/right while preserving a balanced scene. This is a finished game illustration, not a mockup of a screen.

scenes.01-street-court: A low, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a small neighbourhood street-game court in warm late afternoon. One modest dented unbranded tin can sits inside a chalk circle, a single blue rubber flip-flop rests nearby on the asphalt, both physically grounded and correctly scaled. A compact corner shop, concrete garden wall, simple gate and a short laundry line form a cropped background. Emphasize readable can/slipper forms, a few scuffed chalk strokes and long graphic shadows. The road is calm and spacious. No floating enormous slipper, no action trails. Objects look constructed from appealing simple volumes.
scenes.02-lagoon-deck: A quiet timber game deck in a sheltered stilt-house village over turquoise water. A small unbranded tin can and one coral rubber slipper are the clear focal objects on the deck near a white chalk mark. Off to one side a narrow pointed canoe is tied alongside slender timber piles; two modest weathered wood stilt homes sit farther away with open water between them. Show a few useful construction details: uneven plank ends, rope knot, patched roof edge. Warm timber, restrained turquoise water and dark ink; stylised flat shapes, clean shadows. No tropical resort, fantasy palace, photoreal water, decorative ethnic symbols, or excessive micro-detail.
scenes.03-rooftop-court: A playful residential roofdeck court at the end of the afternoon. An unbranded tin can and a pair of simple rubber slippers sit beside chalk court lines; a short laundry line, low safety rail, rectangular teal swimming pool and a few squared city buildings establish the rooftop. A warm persimmon sky with two broad angular clouds, lavender shadows and honey-lit concrete. Use bold graphic composition and clean flat shadow shapes, with a clear low silhouette and breathing room. The pool is peripheral and the court is the subject; no people, no dramatic battle, no photoreal skyline, no neon or lens flare.

purpose: Replace rejected loading illustration; rotate roughly every five seconds; tips inline.
